review_scope: Actual rendered catalogue, all 12 asset thumbnails and three staged furniture views. Asset-side visual QA, not engine testing.
observations: Twelve distinct silhouettes and constructions, with coherent muted fabric/wood/painted-steel palette.
Open wicker hamper, bare bed spring deck, open shelving and wardrobe/cabinet cavities are geometric.
All source lowest vertices now align with local Z=0. Authored X/Y body-reference pivots intentionally preserve asymmetric handles and open mechanisms.
No visible floating parts or asset-to-asset intersections in the final staging views.
Catalogue labels and dimension/triangle captions fit their panels; footer is separate.
revisions: Corrected contact-sheet footer overlap discovered on the first full-sheet inspection.
Removed 1–15 mm primitive-derived ground clearances in five models, regenerated GLBs/source and refreshed affected images.
Clarified body-reference pivot policy and double-sided rendering in node metadata, manifest and README.
Added a useful coloured native-library viewport overview.
known_limits: Static furniture articulation and merged loose components; no animation or runtime physics.
All exported materials are double-sided; receiving renderer should evaluate culling/performance.
Presentation floors and walls are staging only, not additional assets.
